method: Independent cold visual inspection of each original image using vision_analyze; relevant parent review-ledger entries read only after all original inspections.
scope: Static visual review only; no art edits, screenshot regeneration, or kanban transitions.

observations.desktop_closed: Ivory veined body, green lid rim and block feet, coral/ivory raised floral ornament and scattered geometric inlays, brass corner caps and front clasp are intact and fully framed.
observations.desktop_open: Green patterned inner lid and empty recessed cavity are visible with rear hinges and released clasp. Dark separation at rear joint gives a floating impression but does not prove detached geometry.
observations.mobile_closed: Whole chest, ornaments and feet fit; title and both controls fit without overflow. Fine diagonal edges look somewhat aliased.
observations.mobile_open: Whole raised lid, projecting clasp and feet fit; green cavity and pale corner blocks remain coherent.
observations.marketing: Same ivory/green body, short green feet, raised coral/ivory motif and brass hardware; top reads softer sage/seafoam rather than the viewer's olive-beige.

finish_and_fidelity_differences: Viewer lid field is more olive/beige and its rim darker than promotional green.
Viewer veining and green lining pattern are more repetitive; relief and fittings are angular. Raised ornament itself is also present in marketing, not a proven inlay defect.
limitations: Hinge contact, cavity floor and motion not certified from stills; apparent rear clearance is not proof of broken attachment.
entries.parent_reconciliation: Parent candidate result agrees with cold review; no approval inferred.
entries.reason: Reference identity and complete framing preserved; no unequivocal structural defect observed.

observations.desktop_closed: Crimson felt-like panels, brown frame, ivory horn/loop scrolls and stitch borders, central diamond, brass clasp/caps and trimmed block feet are visible and uncropped.
observations.desktop_open: Plain brown underside and brown cavity show rear hinge fittings; rear separation is apparent but hardware disconnection is not established.
observations.mobile_closed: Full silhouette and controls fit. Ivory motifs and brass latch remain legible despite coarse small details.
observations.mobile_open: Raised lid and released tab fit; brown empty interior is coherent, without a demonstrated missing lining or panel.
observations.marketing: Dusty rose panels and matte leather-like brown frame carry the same ivory paired loops, stitch lines, diamond and brass-capped feet.

finish_and_fidelity_differences: Viewer crimson is stronger than the muted rose promotional panels.
Frame, felt, scrolls and brass are less tactile and more faceted; broken-looking loop openings are not independently established damage.
limitations: Closed marketing cannot establish intended interior lining; fine hinge and ornament attachments remain unresolved.
entries.parent_reconciliation: Parent candidate result agrees; no new approval.
entries.reason: Design identity and desktop/mobile framing remain coherent with color and finish differences only.

observations.desktop_closed: Pale rippled body and block feet, turquoise inset, elongated raised dune and brass fittings fit fully. Visible body corners are pale.
observations.desktop_open: Pale rippled underside and empty cavity, teal rim and rear hinge barrels are visible. Dark rear clearance does not independently prove detachment.
observations.mobile_closed: Dune, aqua field, pale corner framing and brass clasp are readable; object and UI remain uncropped.
observations.mobile_open: Pale interior and lid, interrupted teal rim and projecting clasp remain in frame with no unequivocal breakage.
observations.marketing: Ivory grained body, pale aqua panel, raised elongated motif and brass hardware include conspicuous black vertical corner strips, unlike the pale model corners. Motif edging is uneven-looking; adhesive or physical damage cannot be established from promotional imagery.

fidelity_decisions.issue: Black vertical body-corner accents in marketing are not visibly reproduced on the model's pale corners.
fidelity_decisions.classification: Concrete reference/model appearance discrepancy, not proven broken mesh.
fidelity_decisions.required_decision: User must accept pale corners as an intentional variant or direct alignment. Preserve existing hold; do not invent geometry from promotional imagery.

finish_and_fidelity_differences: Viewer has more regular horizontal ripples, a stronger turquoise seam and more angular dune relief than the softly grained promotional finish.
limitations: Promotional strips are not proof of separate physical components; hidden corners and hinge mechanics remain unverified.
entries.parent_reconciliation: Parent needs-decision hold explicitly retained. Cold inspection identified black promotional corner strips versus pale model framing; parent confirms this is the outstanding fidelity decision.
entries.reason: Complete image review does not resolve the existing corner-trim acceptance hold; user decision remains required.

observations.desktop_closed: Cream woven grid, alternating corner bands, turquoise seam, raised ivory lagoon ring and rod/node chart panel are present. Brass clasp, round front fitting, side ring and pale irregular feet remain visible.
observations.desktop_open: Woven lid underside and cavity walls, turquoise opening rim and hinge fittings are visible; floor is partly obscured. Complete silhouette fits.
observations.mobile_closed: Lid motifs and fittings remain recognizable with no clipping; organic feet are not proven broken or detached.
observations.mobile_open: Raised lid, hardware, feet and controls fit. Interior depth and fine hinge attachment are hard to resolve.
observations.marketing: Same grid body, turquoise oval ring and rectangular rod/node ornament, brass fittings and irregular pale feet with smoother sheen and clearer small details.

finish_and_fidelity_differences: Viewer weave is more uniform, lagoon accents flatter and brass less polished.
Fine chart rods/nodes are less legible on mobile; feet remain organic rather than conventional furniture supports in both reference and model.
limitations: Chart crossing attachment, cultural interpretation, cavity floor and hidden support geometry are not certified.
entries.parent_reconciliation: Parent candidate result agrees; no new approval.
entries.reason: Recognizable reference arrangement and complete open/closed framing, with no demonstrated structural failure.

observations.desktop_closed: Pale faceted peaks, turquoise gorge and green vegetation row sit above pale body and forest-green seam; brass clasp/disc/side ring/caps and pale rounded feet are intact and framed.
observations.desktop_open: Plain pale patterned inner lid and cavity with green rim and rear hinges fit fully. Rear hardware contacts and floor are partly hidden.
observations.mobile_closed: Full terrain silhouette and feet fit; title wraps naturally. Clasp and circular fitting look crowded but do not establish intersection.
observations.mobile_open: Open lid and projecting tab fit. Repeated diagonal/checkered shading is conspicuous across pale surfaces; not independently established mesh damage.
observations.marketing: Matching faceted white mountain ridge, winding turquoise river, green oval vegetation, gold fittings and rock-like feet, with smoother matte/satin pale surfaces.

finish_and_fidelity_differences: Viewer pale surfaces show stronger repeating diagonal/ripple shading than smooth promotional finish.
Terrain, vegetation, feet and metal reflections read coarser; foot-to-body transitions are less refined but no detached support is demonstrated.
limitations: Terrain is on the turned-away outer lid in open views, not demonstrated missing. Motion clearance, fine hinges and hidden feet are not validated.
entries.parent_reconciliation: Parent candidate result agrees; no new approval.
entries.reason: Landscape identity, hardware and desktop/mobile framing retained; visible polish differences do not establish structural defects.
